checks.title: Supply chain
items: Unpinned action references (`uses: owner/repo@v1`) — a moved tag changes what runs inside a pinned consumer.
`curl | sh` style installs without a checksum.
Images without a digest or an explicit tag.

checks.title: Secrets and permissions
items: `permissions:` missing on a workflow that does not need write access.
Untrusted context interpolated into `run:` (`${{ github.event.* }}`, PR titles, branch names) — script injection.

checks.title: Trigger safety
items: `pull_request_target` combined with checking out and running PR code.
`workflow_run` that trusts artifacts from a fork.
Missing `concurrency` on long jobs that can pile up.

examples.note: pinned with a version comment, permissions declared
examples.code:
permissions:
  contents: read
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

examples.note: floating tag plus a secret in the shell
examples.code:
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v4
  - run: echo "${{ secrets.TOKEN }}" > /tmp/t
